prompt:
Create a production-quality original animation source sheet for KURTZ, a unique massive dark-fantasy armored knight boss in a painted isometric RPG. Broad heavy torso, huge spiked blackened steel pauldrons, engraved heavy full plate, ornate CLOSED pointed horn-like helmet with narrow dark visor, dark crimson scarf and skull clasp, articulated steel greaves and gauntlets, LONG TORN DARK SCARLET CAPE. A broad long steel greatsword is ALWAYS held and swung by his anatomical RIGHT hand; anatomical LEFT hand stays empty, never changes weapon ownership. No shield, no second weapon. Maintain EXACTLY the same helmet, armor decoration, body proportions and sword across all four poses. Mythic-tier detailed hand-painted game art, readable heavy silhouette, coherent anatomy.
Exactly FOUR separated complete full-body sprites in TWO COLUMNS by TWO ROWS on a square 2048x2048 transparent sheet. Each character body around400px high, all equipment including entire cape and sword inside its own cell, at least110px clear transparent border to cell edges. No overlaps, no frame edges, no text, no labels, no effects, no ground shadows. Transparent background.
ALL FOUR face EAST: fixed pure screen-RIGHT side view, slight top-down camera at a consistent angle. Never turn chest or visor toward viewer, never face left. Near shoulder overlaps far shoulder; helmet visor faces right. Anatomical RIGHT weapon arm is the near visible arm with an unbroken shoulder-elbow-wrist-sword connection. Both boots remain readable and grounded.
FOUR distinct sequential ATTACK poses in row-major order: (0 upper-left) weight shifts onto rear boot, right arm draws greatsword back low for windup; (1 upper-right) torso coils and sword draws high behind the right shoulder, left empty arm balances; (2 lower-left) unmistakable contact: heavy forward lunge and right hand drives greatsword horizontally TOWARD SCREEN RIGHT at opponent torso height, blade reaches forward, NEVER stays above helmet, left empty hand behind for balance; (3 lower-right) follow-through and recovering stance, sword tip remains screen right low, cape settles with inertia. Clearly different joint poses, consistent sword size. Maintain KURTZ's unique broad spiked plate/red cape identity. Entire hand, feet, sword tip and cape must be visible with generous inset.
source_basis: New dedicated artwork; established project identity described explicitly, no external original game art imported.
